simple.summary: צְפָתָה (Tsᵉphâthâh) means Tsephathah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 2Chr 14 9.

definitions.full: H6859. Tsephathah צְפַ֫תָה proper name, of a location in Judah (van d. H. צְפָתָה , so Kit); צ ׳בְּנֵיא לְמָרֵשָׁה 2Chr 14:9 ; ᵐ5 κατὰ βορρᾶν , whence Hi and others, propose צָפֹנָה so Buhl Lex . צִצִּים see צִיץ below I. צוץ . צָקוּן Isa 26:16 see II. צוק .
